about:
Precision Steel operates from Fargo, North Dakota, serving the tri-state region of Minnesota, North Dakota, and South Dakota. The locally owned and operated construction company does not disclose its founding year or founders. It began as a Minnesota-based firm focused on structural steel services for builders and construction crews.

The company specializes in structural steel erection, welding, and metal decking installation. Erection crews handle hoisting, layout, placement, connecting, welding, burning, guying, bracing, bolting, plumbing, and rigging of structural steel, steel joists, bridge girders, and metal buildings. Decking teams review plans and drawings to install floor deck systems from recognized manufacturers, emphasizing proper fastening and rapid turnover for follow-on trades. Welding services cover construction welding using advanced techniques and equipment.

Projects span government buildings, strip malls and retail centers, service stations, churches, and schools. Customers include general contractors and developers across commercial, institutional, and religious sectors in the upper Midwest.

Precision Steel emphasizes speed and safety, aiming to complete deck installation quickly so subsequent crews can proceed without delay. The firm cites its local ownership, tri-state reach, and commitment to quality and safety as differentiators.
